name: WATCHING YOU
source:
WATCHING YOU is a simple game, you are a person and you are going to sleep.

HE wakes you up and you fix him ramen.

[From [url=https://evelcultleader.itch.io/watching-you]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《WATCHING YOU》是一款简单的游戏：你是一个准备睡觉的人。

他把你叫醒，你为他煮了一碗拉面。

[摘自[url=https://evelcultleader.itch.io/watching-you]itch.io[/url]]
